what: The runs behind the README's performance tables and the LongBench v2 result, on four Sparks set up from scratch with ./setup.sh
image_tag_covers: git's hashes of scripts/config.sh ENGINE_PATHS (zig/, build.zig, build.zig.zon, .zig-version, tools/dsv41-zig, the licence files): a build of any commit with the same engine files prints this tag

kernel_kit.fetched: from its published default by the setup

hardware: 4 x Dell Pro Max with GB10 (DGX Spark platform), one ConnectX-7 200G port each, one switch, RoCE v2 with PFC on priority 3

settings.all_runs: scripts/served.sh as shipped: the 1M window, GPU clock limit 2200 MHz
settings.longbench2-long-thinking-off.jsonl: the shipped defaults (prompt cache and SSD tier on), thinking off

client: a separate machine on the same network, one process, the repository's own tools
removed: the client's host name, the engine's address, wall-clock times and local paths; nothing else is changed
